restoration_note: Teaching 81 develops two correspondences. First (ch.83.44–50): the cosmos as the body of the New/Old Man, with Jesus the Youth, the Protomē/Virgin of Light, and the beauty of uprightness as inner image. Second (ch.83.64–128): the formation of pearls — divine influx (rain) descending into receptive vessels (oysters) within the natural sea — and divers (ⲭⲁⲗⲕⲙ̄ⲥⲉ) bringing them up to kings. Third (ch.86.46–103): the soul that wears the body, settled by the Mind of Light or disturbed by what enters via food/drink from below. Editor proposals for the highly formulaic vocabulary (ⲡⲗⲁⲥⲥⲉ, ⲙⲁⲣⲅⲁⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥ, ⲙⲟⲩⲛϩⲱⲟⲩ, ⲧⲗⲧⲗⲉ, ⲧⲃⲏⲧⲉ, ⲫⲁⲗⲁⲥⲥⲁ, ⲧⲁⲣⲁⲭⲏ) are confirmed at high confidence. Long lacunae in 4557 (the analogical gloss), 4561–4564 (downpour-of-rain repetitions), 4596–4599 (the place within great Iaos-gems), and several 4-letter mid-line gaps in ch.86.71+ lacking formula are honestly marked unrestorable.
